customer_reply: Hello, thank you for reaching out to Zycus Support. We understand you are experiencing error E-2207 when sending supplier agreements for e-signature, blocking two contracts. This is typically caused by an expired integration credential. Please have your tenant administrator navigate to Admin > Integrations > Credentials, regenerate the credential, update it in the connected system, and then trigger a manual sync to resolve the issue. If the error persists after completing these steps, please let us know so we can assist further.
